name: Ricardo Alonso
bio:
Ricardo Alonso's motorsport journey began in the dusty pampas of Argentina, tinkering with engines on his family's farm. This hands-on experience fueled a passion that led him to pursue a degree in mechanical engineering. After graduating, Ricardo joined a local racing team, quickly rising through the ranks from a junior mechanic to a race engineer. His knack for optimizing performance and streamlining operations caught the eye of Tolman Motorsport.

At Tolman, Ricardo brings a 'big picture' perspective, always looking for innovative solutions to improve team efficiency and competitiveness. He believes in empowering his team members and fostering a collaborative environment where ideas can flourish. His ambitious nature and unwavering commitment to excellence make him a driving force within the organization, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible.

 Ricardo is very focused on team moral, and will often engage in activities such as team building to help keep his crew focused and effective. He understands that motorsports is a team effort, and that his team must function as a unit if they are to succeed.

physical.description: A man of medium height with a strong build.

quirks: Always carries a worn notebook filled with technical diagrams.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Starts every team meeting with a motivational quote.
